title: Split carousel-frame.md into its own folder, and heal the stale Apply section
description: docs/playbooks/add-flow/ui/carousel-frame.md is 496 lines against the 200-line budget - flagged in two prior sessions' handoffs at 416 lines and never actioned. Split it into docs/playbooks/add-flow/ui/carousel-frame/ following the precedent set by result-pane.md (split out of 04-overlay-and-shell.md for the same reason, MPI-638). While mapping it, its section 'Results are not real until Apply' was found STALE: MpiBaseFlow no longer uses deferCommit, there is no _apply and no 'Not saved yet' note; hold-until-Apply was built as MPI-306 Phase 3 and REMOVED after the UX pass. The doc still presents it as shipped.
acceptance: carousel-frame.md is replaced by carousel-frame/ - a README hub plus topic files, every file under the 200-line budget
The split is faithful: no durable fact is dropped, and each file keeps the MPI-number attributions the sections carry

The stale 'Results are not real until Apply' section is corrected to what the code actually does (results commit on completion; deferCommit survives as a generationService primitive used by MpiGroupHistoryBlock and MpiStepCutout, not by MpiBaseFlow), not carried forward as shipped behaviour
Every inbound link is repointed at the right split file, including section anchors: 9 markdown references and 11 JS/spec comment references
release-baselines/*.json are NOT touched - they are manifests of shipped artifacts, not references to the current tree (MPI-409)
ui/README.md's pattern table routes to the new folder
